title: MolReJev: Decision Models Are In-Context Molecular Predictors
abstract: arXiv:2611.28965v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Molecular prediction helps prioritize compounds for screening. Specialized predictors are trained for a fixed set of tasks, limiting cross-task generalization. Language models can condition on task descriptions and have recently shown promise in molecular prediction. However, generating answers token by token adds inference cost, and general-purpose models often lack task-specific molecular knowledge. We thus propose MolReJev, which combines Jev-style candidate scoring with in-context learning (ICL) on a language model. MolReJev retrieves similar labeled examples from existing task data and scores candidate labels jointly in one forward pass. ICL improves predictions from the released general-purpose Kev checkpoint and the separately trained MolReJev. For the trained model, gains span all evaluation groups, including held-out tasks, and extend to compounds absent from training. MolReJev generally outperforms MolecularGPT on matched eva

translated_title: MolReJev：决策模型是上下文分子预测器
translated_abstract: 分子预测有助于在化合物筛选中进行优先级排序。专用预测器通常针对固定的任务集进行训练，限制了跨任务的泛化能力。语言模型能够以任务描述为条件，近期在分子预测中展现出潜力。然而，逐个token生成答案增加了推理成本，且通用模型往往缺乏特定任务的分子知识。因此，我们提出了MolReJev，它将Jev式候选评分与语言模型上的上下文学习相结合。MolReJev从现有任务数据中检索相似的标注示例，并在一次前向传播中联合评分候选标签。上下文学习（ICL）改进了已发布的通用Kev检查点和单独训练的MolReJev的预测表现。对于训练后的模型，性能提升涵盖所有评估组（包括保留任务），并扩展到训练集中未出现的化合物。MolReJev在匹配的评估中总体上优于MolecularGPT。
tldr: MolReJev将候选标签联合评分与语言模型上下文学习相结合，实现了高效且具备跨任务泛化能力的分子性质预测，在保留任务和未见化合物上均取得提升并优于MolecularGPT。
en_tdlr: MolReJev combines Jev-style candidate scoring with in-context learning on language models, enabling efficient molecular prediction with strong cross-task generalization that outperforms MolecularGPT.
